raw_text:
VERDICT goal: §12's goal is that a follower re-arm case cannot end the runner hosting it. The follower replaces its own process image when the content stamp over its source moves while it is attached, and the three re-arm cases drive the real follower command, so a stamp moved mid-case re-executed the xdist worker and every case queued on it; commit 97fa44072 runs each arming in a child process the test owns and freezes the code stamp per case, so no case can reach os.execve, os._exit or a signal path that runs in the runner.
VERDICT done_when: the done-when is a loaded loop of each test 30 times under -n 8 beside a CPU load generator that finishes with no crashed worker, with the current revision as the negative control crashing at least one. Measured: head arm 30 iterations, 0 crashed workers, 0 follower reload launchers naming the head tree; base arm reproduced 9 crashed workers and 9 reload launchers in its single loaded iteration (logs/base_iter_1.log, logs/base_iter_1.exec.reload-launcher.txt). Without the loop's source edit both revisions run 45 passed (base_nomover 1 iteration, head_nomover 3 iterations), so the crash is trigger-based rather than load-based.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit (97fa44072 tests, 1b0fa5af3 evidence). Each of the three test files gains an autouse fixture holding runs.follower_code_stamp still and a _CHILD_ARMING harness that runs the follower via subprocess in a child, applies the case's capture/patches inside the child, and raises on a child that ends without returning a payload; test_producer_takes_new_code.py routes the two output-surface cases through _follow_in_a_child with a producer-live hint, keeping the producer under measure a process of its own. No production source changes.
VERDICT manifest: read; it states commits 97fa44072 (fix) and 1b0fa5af3 (fragment), base arm 10 failed/35 passed EXIT=1, head arm 30 iterations with 0 crashed workers and 4 green, negative control logs/base_iter_1.log; every log path it names exists and each header line names the revision quoted.
VERDICT write_paths: the diff 0f5941a18..1b0fa5af3 touches exactly four files, all declared: tests/test_follower_rearm_shows_nothing_twice.py, tests/test_follow_rearm_continues.py, tests/test_producer_takes_new_code.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-follower-outlives-its-monitor/a-rearm-test-never-ends-its-worker.html (the declared docs/figures directory was not used).
